reason: Both plans satisfy all hard requirements (three-plus named phases with percentages/entry criteria, correctly formatted RISK lines, numeric halt metrics, and no decommissioning in the same phase as the final migration batch), but Response B is the more complete and actionable plan: it adds a distinct, well-gated Legacy Decommission phase (30-day soak, financial close, archival verification) instead of just declaring decommissioning out of scope, and its batch strategy (segmenting by complexity, migrating enterprise/high-revenue accounts last, per-batch shadow reconciliation before cutover) shows more realistic domain reasoning than Response A's plan.
